newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Nashville, Tenn..

text.p: BOOK-ENTRY-ONLY SUMMARY NOTICE OF SALE
Metropolitan Government of Nashville and Davidson County
General Obligation Public Improvement Bonds, Series 1996A Sealed bids will be received by the Metropolitan

Government of Nashville and Davidson County (Metropolitan Government'') at the Office of the Metropolitan Clerk, Room 205, Metropolitan Courthouse, Nashville, Tennessee 37201 until 10:00 A.M., Nashville, Tennessee time on:
October 15, 1996

for the purchase of $96,135,000* General Obligation Public Improvement Bonds, Series 1996A (the Bonds''), subject to the terms and conditions of the Official Notice of Sale. The Bonds will be general obligations of the Metropolitan Government and the full faith and credit of the Metropolitan Government are pledged to the payment of the principal of and interest on the Bonds. The Bonds will be dated October 1, 1996, will bear interest payable on May 15 and November 15 of each year to maturity, commencing May 15, 1997, and will mature in annual installments on November 15 as set forth below:
Initial Maturity Schedule
Principal Principal Principal
Year Amount* Year Amount* Year Amount*

The Metropolitan Government reserves the right to increase or decrease the principal amount of each maturity or sinking fund redemption shortly following the opening of bids by amounts not to exceed the lesser of 10% of the respective principal amount or $300,000, as described in the Official Notice of Sale. The Metropolitan Government also reserves the right to postpone the date established for the receipt of bids as described in the Official Notice of Sale.

The Bonds shall be sold at a rate or rates not exceeding seven percent (7%) per annum. The Bonds will be dated October 1, 1996. No bid will be considered for less than ninety-nine percent (99%) or more than one hundred-two percent (102%) of par and accrued interest. The Bonds will be awarded to the bidder whose bid results in the lowest true interest cost on the Bonds calculated as set forth in the Official Notice of Sale. The Bonds will be awarded on the sale date by the Metropolitan County Council. The Bonds that mature on or after November 15, 2006, are subject to redemption on or after November 15, 2005, as described in the Official Notice of Sale.
The Bonds will be issued in registered form by means of a book-entry system with no physical distribution of bond

certificates made to the public. One bond certificate each maturity will be issued to The Depository Trust Company, New York, New York (DTC''), and im mobilized in its custody. The Bonds will be delivered to DTC on or about October 29, 1996, in New York, New York upon payment of the balance due on the total purchase price in FEDERALFUNDS. The approving legal opinion of Bass, Berry & Sims PLC,
Nashville, Tennessee, and Jones &Shockley, Nashville,
Tennessee, co-bond counsel, will be furnished without cost to the purchaser. Copies of the Preliminary Official

Statement, the Official Notice of Sale and Official Bid Form for the Bonds or further information may be obtained without cost from the City's Financial Advisor, Public Financial Management, Inc., Two Logan Square, Suite 1600, 18th and Arch Streets, Philadelphia, Pennsylvania 19103, (215) 567- 6100 (Attention:Stephanie Rosner), or from the Finance Department, Metro Courthouse, Room 106, Nashville, Tennessee 37201, (615) 862-6151.
Metropolitan Government of Nashville and Davidson County
By: Joe Huddleston,
Director of Finance
(From The Bond Buyer)
